capabilities: Evaluate math expressions in code blocks and inline code with a trigger prefix
Calculate with units, unit conversions, currency symbols, functions, and number bases
Define note-wide variables, reference previous results, and compute totals
Use frontmatter, Dataview fields, and cross-note metadata as variables in calculations
Insert results back into notes as Dataview-style inline metadata
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX math typesetting tool; it evaluates calculations and renders the results, including an optional TeX-style render mode.
extras: The README documents features split between stable 1.10.2 and an unpublished 1.11.0 'recovery preview' (inline TeX triggers, currency precision, @format directives); several features described are not yet available in the published release. Numerals treats currencies as units and does not fetch exchange rates.
intentEvidence: Numerals is also inspired by calculator-as-notes apps such as Numi, Numbr, and Soulver.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to evaluate calculations inside notes; math blocks are static and cannot compute units, currencies, or values from note metadata.

relations.evidence: Numerals uses mathjs for calculations and adds Obsidian-friendly preprocessing for currency symbols
obsidian-calc for calculator-style expression evaluation and result insertion
obsidian-mathpad for a fuller computer algebra system inside Obsidian
